subject.title: fix: preserve discovered context limits over static metadata

question: Should prepared model-catalog discovery be authoritative for context limits on the same provider route, with manifest, configured-catalog, and bundled rows serving only as missing-key fallbacks while explicit user context overrides remain separate?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but this chooses the long-term source-of-truth rule for provider capability metadata across all lifecycle consumers; that contract cannot be inferred safely from one provider incident alone.

options.title: Accept live-route authority
options.body: Approve the proposed precedence rule, then require a current-main rebase and focused regression proof before merge.

options.title: Keep conservative merged minima
options.body: Retain the current behavior if static metadata is intentionally the safety ceiling, and close this PR with a documented provider-specific alternative.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Specify the providers or discovery contracts that may override static metadata before landing a smaller scoped implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept live-route authority
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed precedence rule, then require a current-main rebase and focused regression proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged lifecycle refactor establishes the prepared catalog owner boundary and its source-precedence contract.
